authority: Project lead autonomous proposal under CNY10000 mandate; no independent approval claimed.
economic_prediction: A positive US option-implied minus backward realized variance gap proxies compensation for global uncertainty, which may also support subsequent Chinese equity returns. Test positive gross selected returns and a positive exposure-matched selection effect; neither the transfer nor the sign is established for China.

method_basis.version: Bollerslev, Marrone, Xu and Zhou, December2011 FEDS2011-52
method_basis.sections: 3.1 daily squared-return monthly measurement;3.3 capitalization-weighted six-country global measure;2.2-2.3 finite-sample and overlap limitations
method_basis.not_replication: This is an autonomous single-US-proxy to China hypothesis, not the paper's six-country capital-weighted index or a replication of the2009 intraday estimator. The paper does not include China or establish a profitable zero-threshold long-only rule.
counterexamples: Chinese capital controls, local cash-flow shocks or segmentation can break the cross-market channel
A realized-variance proxy is not conditional expected variance and may reverse sign in crises
Positive variance insurance compensation need not imply positive equity returns or timing alpha
Selling volatility and buying an ETF have different cash flows; only the latter is in scope

fixed_signal.observation_dates: Last US trading session of December, March, June and September immediately before each entry quarter
fixed_signal.unit: percent-squared monthly approximation; annualVIX/12 conversion and variable calendar-month lengths are explicit approximations
fixed_signal.selected: Strictly x_m>0; zero or negative cash. Missing inputs are blockers, never cash or imputed zero.
fixed_signal.entry: Second CN exchange session of January, April, July or October at raw open. Compute after the first CN session closes, using only the completed prior US calendar month; timezone and actual publication conventions must be reviewed before admission.
fixed_signal.exit: Next scheduled quarterly entry anchor; continue holdings across adjacent selected quarters in any later account simulation, without synthetic free monthly rebalancing.

fixed_window.rationale: First full calendar year after510300's2012 launch through the last full calendar-quarter endpoint before the existing2024-06-28 research cutoff. No selection based on new outcomes.

deduplication: Distinct from closed domestic ETF realized-volatility cross-sectional factors,50ETF option-volume relative activity, and cross-border overnight price/NAV translation. Some global risk information may overlap labor and other macro states; statistical independence is unverified. Do not reopen any consumed authorization.
